body: Added a Commands reference table covering all 7 real registered commands (was missing /gta7jail, /gta7hospital, /sudoku entirely from the player-facing docs — they only existed in CLAUDE.md's dev status notes and plugin.yml). Added a new CRAZY_KRANKENVAGEN how-to-play section covering both the driven boat/hospital-delivery mission and the self-service llama-mount rescue, and the low-health auto-dispatch behavior, none of which were previously documented for players. Verified against the real registered commands in plugin.yml and GTA7Plugin.java's setExecutor calls, and the real mechanics in KrankenvagenManager/Listener, JailCommand, HospitalCommand, SudokuCommand, RespawnGearListener.
title: Full README rewrite — complete command reference + CRAZY_KRANKENVAGEN section
